patch_description: Key parameters changed: (1) neighborhood moves from window-limited pairwise swaps to random insertion moves (remove a txn from position i, reinsert at position j) — a strictly richer neighborhood for makespan minimization; (2) best-improvement descent replaced by simulated-annealing acceptance with temperature decaying over a ~90s time budget, allowing sideways/worsening moves to escape local optima; (3) greedy construction kept but simplified (random start, no costly full-cost start scan), and the search loop restarts perturbation ("reheat") if stuck. Best-so-far schedule is tracked separately and returned. This combines proven greedy construction with a stronger neighborhood (insertion) and a stronger search strategy (annealing), which should lower makespan below the current 296 baseline.
